chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ali ibn Ma'bad, from Abdullah ibn al-Qasim, from Yunus ibn 'Abd al-Rahman, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:

Indeed, Allah repels (calamity) through the one from our Shias who prays, from the one from our Shias who does not pray; and if they were all to agree upon neglecting the prayer, they would be destroyed.
And indeed, Allah repels through the one from our Shias who pays the alms-tax, from the one who does not pay; and if they were all to agree upon neglecting the alms-tax, they would be destroyed.
And indeed, Allah repels through the one from our Shias who performs the pilgrimage, from the one who does not; and if they were all to agree upon neglecting the pilgrimage, they would be destroyed.
And this is the Word of Allah, Mighty and Majestic: 'And if it were not for Allah repelling some people by means of others, the earth would surely be corrupted.'
But Allah is Full of Bounty to the worlds.
So by Allah, it was not revealed except regarding you, and it did not mean by it anyone other than you.
ai.seo_question: How does the presence of righteous worshippers protect the entire Shia community from destruction according to this hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi elucidates the Shia doctrine of 'Daf'' (divine repulsion), where the righteous few preserve the community from general corruption, specifically linking the pillars of Salah, Zakat, and Hajj to collective survival. The Imam explicitly claims exclusive revelation of the cited verse (2:251) for the Shia, a point of scholarly debate regarding whether it refers to the broader Muslim community or the specific lineage of the Ahl al-Bayt and their followers.

en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ali Bin Ma’bad, from Abdullah Bin Al Qasim, from Yunus Bin Zabyan, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘

Allahazwj Defends by the ones from ourasws Shias who do pray Salāt, from the ones from ourasws Shias who do not pray Salāt; and were they (all) to gather upon the neglect of the Salāt, they would (all) be destroyed.

And that Allahazwj Defends by the ones from ourasws Shias who do pay Zakāt from the ones who do not pay the Zakāt, and were they (all) to gather upon neglecting the Zakāt, they would (all) be destroyed.

And that Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Defends by the ones from our<sup>asws</sup> Shias who do perform Hajj from the ones who do not perform Hajj, and were they (all) to gather upon neglecting the Hajj, they would (all) be destroyed;
and these are the Words of Allahazwj Mighty and Majestic [2:251] And were it not for Allah's Repelling some men with others, the earth would certainly be in a spoilt state;
but Allah is Gracious to the worlds.
So, by Allah<sup>azwj</sup>! It was not Revealed except regarding you all (Shias), and it does not Mean by it except for you all (Shias)’.
en.sarwar: 1. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from Ali ibn Ma’bad from ‘Abd Allah ibn al-Qasim from Yunus ibn Zabyan from abu ‘Abd Allah (a.s.) who has said the following:

‘‘Allah defends through those of our Shi’a (followers) who perform prayer from those of our Shi’a (followers) who do not perform prayers, and if they all stop praying all of them will face destruction.
Allah defends through those of our Shi’a (followers) who pay al-Zakat (charity) from those who do not pay al-Zakat and if they all stop paying al-Zakat all of them will be destroyed.
Allah defends through those of our Shi’a (followers) who perform Hajj from those who do not perform Hajj and if they all stop performing Hajj all of them will be destroyed.

This is indicated in the words of Allah, the Most Majestic, the Most Holy, ‘Had Allah not defended one group of people through the other, the earth would have been destroyed, but Allah is generous to the worlds.’ [2:251]
This, by Allah, has been revealed about you and no one else is meant thereby.’”
